projects.name: Campus in a rack (senior project)
projects.description: Built a three-building campus network using six Cisco switches and three ISR routers, configured via console. Segmented students, staff, and security cameras into separate broadcast domains connected through a distribution layer. Subnetted a /22 block into allocations for 11 departments. Implemented a link-state routing protocol across three routers in a single backbone area and verified failover convergence in under 10 seconds. Produced a topology diagram and port-by-port cabling sheet.

projects.name: Guest Wi-Fi for the college open day
projects.description: Configured two access points with a separate visitor network and selected non-overlapping channels using a phone-based Wi-Fi analyser.

projects.name: Why is Lab 3 slow?
projects.description: Captured traffic on the lab uplink, identified a faulty network card flooding the segment with broadcast frames, and disabled its port until it was replaced.
